entries.133430533e9734a0: This product category manufactures and sells rolled sheet and foil products of aluminum and its alloys, and is the largest of the five product categories by amount. The main products are aluminum sheets rolled thin and even thinner foil. The main affiliated companies listed are the company, UACJ (Thailand) Co., Ltd., Tri-Arrows Aluminum Holding Inc., Tri-Arrows Aluminum Inc., UACJ Foil Corporation, UACJ Foil Malaysia Sdn. Bhd., Nikkin Corporation, UACJ Aluminum Center Corporation, UACJ Marketing & Processing Corporation and Logan Aluminum Inc., among others. Sheet production facilities are located at the company's Nagoya Works (Minato-ku, Nagoya City) and Fukui Works (Sakai City, Fukui Prefecture), Tri-Arrows Aluminum Inc.'s Logan Plant (Kentucky, USA), and UACJ (Thailand) Co., Ltd.'s Rayong Works (Rayong Province, Kingdom of Thailand), as of March 31, 2026. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,013,661 million (previous year ¥845,836 million). The explanation of operating results states that domestic sales volume of sheet products declined slightly year on year due to weaker domestic demand, while overseas demand for can material remained firm and sales volumes at Tri-Arrows Aluminum Inc. and UACJ (Thailand) Co., Ltd. increased, so total sheet product sales volume rose year on year.
entries.37b53a07f806f69d: This product category manufactures and sells aluminum extruded products and processed products, and also undertakes civil engineering construction contracts related to them. The main affiliated companies are the company, UACJ Extrusion Processing Anjo Corporation, UACJ Extrusion Processing Gunma Corporation, UACJ Extrusion Processing Shiga Corporation, UACJ Extrusion Czech s.r.o., UACJ Extrusion (Thailand) Co., Ltd., UACJ Metal Processing Corporation, UACJ Metal Components North America, Inc., and UACJ Metal Components Mexico, S.A. de C.V. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥79,697 million (previous year ¥70,885 million), the second largest after the sheet product-related category.
entries.4db048ae872578bc: This product category manufactures and sells cast and forged products of aluminum and similar metals. The main affiliated companies are the company and UACJ Foundry & Forging (Vietnam) Co., Ltd., two companies in total. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥18,562 million (previous year ¥13,669 million), the smallest of the five product categories.
entries.571bfcb4e9dcd347: This product category engages in freight transport and handling related to the group's business, and wholesale of products and similar goods. The Description of Business section does not list main affiliated companies for this category. It is shown as one of the product categories in the revenue-by-product table, and since there is no statement that it is outside the reportable segments, it is listed in order of revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥27,215 million (previous year ¥26,876 million), the fourth largest.
entries.5a3460a87867f49a: A manufacturer that makes and sells aluminum sheet and foil, extrusions, castings and forgings, automotive parts, and more.
entries.69b36fa49ccd4073: This business manufactures and sells non-ferrous metals such as aluminum and their alloys as sheets, foils, extruded products, castings, forgings, automotive parts and processed products. The group's sole segment is the Aluminum Products Business, and no breakdown by reportable segment is given. The company and 49 subsidiaries and 12 equity-method affiliates form a corporate group. The Description of Business section lists the main affiliated companies by product category, and within it, revenue from sheet product-related is the largest. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,181,716 million (previous year ¥998,781 million), an increase of 18.3% year on year. By customer location, revenue was ¥404,378 million in Japan (previous year ¥384,487 million), ¥459,109 million in the United States (previous year ¥334,166 million), and ¥318,229 million in other regions (previous year ¥280,128 million). No single external customer accounts for 10% or more of revenue. The increase in revenue is explained by higher sales volume and rising aluminum ingot prices.
